resources.string: Sends one minimal crash report to your own HTTPS collector only after separate consent. The collector must require authentication. You operate it and control its region, retention and data-processing terms. No report is queued or retried.
I consent to send crash reports

Enter an HTTPS endpoint for your own authentication-protected collector (for example, a unique secret path). The address is stored privately, never included in the report, and is deleted with Remove. Saving an address turns consent off; enable it separately to opt in.
Enter an HTTPS URL without login, query or fragment.
Set a collector endpoint before consenting.
